blocks.text: Thank you for turning the access request around so quickly; Daniel Leach had the freight and inventory detail open the same afternoon, and the baseline for {{fact:f:E-2010-001.client}} is moving well because of it. One point is worth flagging while it is still small: the cost file groups inbound and internal transport under a single line, so we cannot yet see what each of them actually costs to run. It is worth separating before we build the benchmark on top of it.

There is nothing urgent in that, and we can carry it as an open item without holding up the rest of the work. If someone on your finance side can re-cut those two into separate lines, or simply point Daniel Leach to where the underlying detail sits, we can close it without waiting on a full re-post. Michael Walker is holding late next week open for the two site sessions, and either day works for us once your managers confirm.

I know this all lands on you, Sandra Flores, in a week that is likely already full, and we have kept the asks as small as the work allows. Send whatever is easiest to me, Deborah Gordon, and I will get it to the team the same day and keep this thread as the running record so nothing has to be chased twice.
